display_long_description:
Sigure: VR Piano Game lets you play anime, J-POP, and classical songs on your own digital piano — no sheet music or lessons required.

Follow the falling notes displayed above your keys, and even beginners can play intuitively. 

Enjoy your favorite anime and J-POP songs, perform freely, and aim for high scores just like in a rhythm game.

[Song List]
https://vrpiano.co.jp/en/english/music/

About 30 songs are included at installation.
Additional songs can be purchased individually.

Over 300 extra songs are available, with new titles added monthly.

[Practice Mode]

If a section is difficult, use Practice Mode to improve at your own pace.

Stay Notes: Notes pause until you press the right key.

Speed Control: Start slow, increase gradually.

Loop Practice: Focus on tricky parts.

One-Hand Mode: Auto accompaniment makes solo practice fun.

[Step-Up Program]

To help beginners learn effectively, Sigure offers a step-by-step course called “Step-Up 30.”

Supervised by an experienced piano teacher for adult beginners, this program guides you from finger basics to smooth playing, helping you build confidence through short, rewarding steps.

Whether you’ve never played piano or gave up years ago, Sigure helps you rediscover the joy of playing.

Feel the notes appear above your real piano and watch your skills grow naturally—through fun, immersive rhythm gameplay.

Requirements:
Meta Quest 3 / 3s headset, a digital piano, and a MIDI cable.
